_comment: C0-17 正文英译 · deepgram（2026-10-26）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」4 行带 .md 链接（assemblyai/whisper/otter/zapier），related 写 4 条（frontmatter related 是 [assemblyai, whisper, zapier]，键按正文链接行对齐=4——otter 行在正文但不在 frontmatter）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 带「实测建议」三条段。

axes.model_access: A self-developed speech model family (Nova-line transcription models, Aura-line TTS models — listed on the official docs models page, developers.deepgram.com/docs/models direct-fetched and verified 2026-10-22); developers pick model tiers and do not train their own models (hosted-API form).
axes.runtime: API/SDK as the main entry (REST + WebSocket + per-language SDKs, official docs surface); **real-time streaming transcription is the flagship** (WebSocket streaming endpoint documented officially); browser/pre-recorded-file endpoints also exist.
axes.local_files: Cloud API — audio uploaded and processed via the API; data-retention policy per the official terms (not verified item by item).
axes.background: Real-time streaming is the core form (transcribe while speaking); batch endpoints alongside; no "keep-running-after-shutdown" concept (API service).
axes.tools: Transcription (multilingual/keyword boosts/punctuation/speaker-diarization parameter surfaces), TTS (Aura line), speech-understanding parameter surfaces (seen in official docs); developer toolchain (SDKs/examples/latency metrics documented).
axes.context: APIs have no memory concept — conversation context is managed entirely by the calling (integrating) side; multi-turn correction is stitched together at the application layer.
axes.permissions: API-key system + usage billing (D9: pricing not collected); an enterprise compliance narrative (SOC2-type certification lines seen on the site, details not verified item by item); data-retention/training switches per the terms (not verified item by item).
axes.fit: Fits: developers building real-time voice apps (support/meetings/caption streams), low-latency transcription API integration, English-leaning high accuracy. Does not fit: non-developers using it directly (it is an API platform, not an end product), privacy-sensitive audio (cloud processing), Chinese-first usage.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **End-to-end latency of WebSocket streaming** (official latency metrics vs real networks)
- **Chinese / Chinese-English mixed-speech transcription accuracy** (the official benchmark is an English-leaning narrative)
- **Where the data-retention switch actually takes effect**
unknowns:
- Data-retention and training-use clause details (not verified item by item)
- Current status of Chinese model tiers (not verified item by item)
- Enterprise-compliance certification list details (not verified item by item)
related: Also the two titans of transcription APIs: AssemblyAI has the better productized docs experience, Deepgram the stronger real-time-stream performance narrative.
Open-source-base contrast: Whisper offers local free privacy boundaries, Deepgram hosted real-time performance.
End-product contrast: Otter is a meeting-transcription product; Deepgram is often the upstream API of such products.
Pipeline downstream: Deepgram transcription results often flow through Zapier-class platforms into ticketing/CRM workflows (cross-linked after filing).
